name: Shelfspan Desk
objective: Reviewed subject classification plus ordered physical bookshelf segmentation with measured widths and growth reserves

closest.name: Slot Orchard
closest.desc: Reconcile rough picking logs with real local MiniLM item inference. Review counts and fixed-item constraints, compare exact one-container-per-slot load-safe layouts against current access-distance estimates, and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown plus layout CSV without uploads or stock movement.

closest.name: Sort Canopy
closest.desc: Reconcile paraphrased card-sort notes with real local MiniLM inference. Review card identities and session piles, require complete decks, compare exact fixed-count navigation groups against source-order pair agreement and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown plus navigation drafts without uploads.

closest.name: Station Loom
closest.desc: Match rough work elements to method cards with real local MiniLM inference. Verify timings and prerequisites, compare exact cycle-bounded station balancing against source-order next-fit, and export complete JSON/CSV/station run sheets/Markdown without uploads or dispatch.

closest.name: Packet Seam
closest.desc: Fit incoming document summaries into ordered reading packets with real local MiniLM embeddings and capacity-constrained insertion planning. Review or hold every placement, preserve original order and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown manifests without uploads.

closest.name: Pack Relay
closest.desc: Turn free-text dispatch needs into handling-aware waves with real local MiniLM inference and capacity-bounded packing. Review procedures, hold ambiguous orders, preserve all units and export a complete JSON/CSV dispatch checklist without content uploads.

closest.name: Folder Ferry
closest.desc: Organize document manifests into purpose-defined folders with real local MiniLM inference. Review or reject routes, resolve filename collisions without moving files, and export a complete reversible JSON/CSV filing plan without content uploads.

difference: No prior physical library intake/shelf planner found. Unlike folder routing or picking-slot assignment, preserve canonical subject-author-title order and optimize contiguous shelf breaks by shelf count, same-subject split boundaries and squared usable slack. No catalog or file changes.
